newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 3.50/4.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 3.50/4.50 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 3.50/4.50 percent in early Friday trading on the back of flush rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank's supply of some 489 billion rupiah into the money market had also kept liquidity flush.
One- and three-month money were at 10.25/10.50 and 12.50/12.75 percent, respectively.
One dealer said liquidity remained flush as the central bank offered only one month SBIs at 10.25 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Thursday was 5.22 percent against 5.50 percent on Wednesday.
